result.explanation: A completion affects only a matching running node. After each event, repeatedly block pending nodes whose prerequisites are failed or blocked, then start all currently eligible pending nodes simultaneously in lexical order. Counterexample: starting a node whose prerequisite merely completed in the same event would violate the running-state requirement.
result.mapping: For each node, state is one of pending, running, done, failed, or blocked; dependencies map prerequisite IDs to nodes. The returned started list is the lexical set transitioned pending→running after propagation.
result.assumptions: Event type ok marks a matching running node done; fail marks it failed; all other completion events are ignored. Poll only triggers propagation and scheduling. Config remains available on every call.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let d=input.config.deps,k=Object.keys(d).sort(),s={};k.forEach(x=>s[x]='pending');for(let z=0;z<output.length;z++){let e=input.events[z];if(e&&((e.type==='ok')||(e.type==='fail'))&&s[e.id]==='running')s[e.id]=e.type==='ok'?'done':'failed';let ch=true;while(ch){ch=false;for(let x of k)if(s[x]==='pending'&&d[x].some(q=>s[q]==='failed'||s[q]==='blocked'))s[x]='blocked',ch=true}let a=[];for(let x of k)if(s[x]==='pending'&&d[x].every(q=>s[q]==='done'))s[x]='running',a.push(x);let o=output[z];if(!o||JSON.stringify(o.started)!==JSON.stringify(a))return false;let t={};k.forEach(x=>t[x]=s[x]);if(JSON.stringify(o.states)!==JSON.stringify(t))return false}return true}
result.program: function solve({config,state,event}){let d=config.deps,k=Object.keys(d).sort(),s=state?state.s:Object.fromEntries(k.map(x=>[x,'pending']));if(event&&(event.type==='ok'||event.type==='fail')&&s[event.id]==='running')s[event.id]=event.type==='ok'?'done':'failed';let ch=true;while(ch){ch=false;for(let x of k)if(s[x]==='pending'&&d[x].some(q=>s[q]==='failed'||s[q]==='blocked')){s[x]='blocked';ch=true}}let a=[];for(let x of k)if(s[x]==='pending'&&d[x].every(q=>s[q]==='done')){s[x]='running';a.push(x)}let t={};for(let x of k)t[x]=s[x];return {state:{s:s},output:{started:a,states:t}}}
